name: Info Banner
description: Displays a configurable site banner (top of page, a div, or a popup) with wildcard path targeting.
project_description:
Info Banner allows you to display configurable, site-wide notifications across your Drupal website.

 Easily create banners for announcements, promotions, or maintenance messages — and control exactly when and where they appear, all without custom code.

 Key Features 

Flexible display options — top-of-page banner, modal popup, or injected into a specific DOM element

Block integration — create multiple independent banners via the included submodule

Rich text support — fully compatible with Drupal text formats

Scheduling — define start and end dates for automatic activation and expiration

User dismissal — optional close button with cookie-based tracking

Visibility rules — control display by path conditions

Drupal 10 & 11 compatible and cache-friendly

 

Use Cases 

Maintenance notices

Emergency alerts

Legal disclaimers

Promotional messages

Time-sensitive announcements

 Info Banner provides a lightweight, flexible, and Drupal-native solution for managing important user-facing messages across your site.
